title: Booker T. Washington High School band and classmates
summary: Toussaint played in the beginners band at Booker T., left to tour with Shirley and Lee, and names schoolmates.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, what about school? Did you play in bands at school?
In high school I played in the C band. Never the senior band. Only the beginners band. I played different instruments in the beginners band, but never got to the senior band.

Booker, Washington. Yeah. And then I went to Coyne for a few months. I quit Booker T to go out and play a bit. Reached the Guild Complex and thought I'd go back to school for ten minutes. I did, pretending. That being Coyne, at that time I left to go with Sheryl and Lee on the road. But I considered Booker T because I spent most of the time there. I spent an hour there. Meaning about three years, almost three years.
Were there any other musicians there with you? Any other musicians at Booker T with you?

Oh yeah, there was the senior band, the C band. Right. Well, if you mean of any names that we might have. Yes. James Rippers was in my class. Sam Alcorn, Jr. And the Sugar Boy was a few grades ahead when I got there he was leaving. He would shout. He would shout.
I remember the locks. I used to be in the record business in 1949, 50 and have been off and on.
